source: CTD TreeNumbers and ParentTreeNumbers from CTD_chemicals.tsv.gz
notes: A chemical is core when any CTD TreeNumber or ParentTreeNumber is a descendant of one of the listed MeSH paths.

DrugBankID is not present in the current CTD_chemicals.tsv.gz header. As deterministic fallbacks, the script uses the prespecified CTD drug-semantic regex and the locally supplied DrugCentral CAS/INN reference; this is not manual name review.
DrugCentral reference file: structures.smiles.tsv, downloaded from the official DrugCentral download endpoint; it is used only for drug exclusion and is not part of the CRC enrichment model.

For the PAHs branch only, PubChem MolecularFormula is used as a structure-level guard: the PAH label requires a C/H-only molecular formula; compounds without a retrievable formula or with heteroatoms remain excluded from that class.
The environmental_pollutants rule is broad and is retained as a prespecified core class; class-specific results are reported separately.
